description: Apply data validation to a spreadsheet in WPS Spreadsheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/project_tracker.xlsx which contains project tracking data with columns: Project Name, Start Date, End Date, Budget, Status, Priority, Assigned To. Apply data validation rules: (1) Status column must be dropdown (Not Started, In Progress, On Hold, Completed, Cancelled), (2) Priority column must be dropdown (Low, Medium, High, Critical), (3) Budget column must be number greater than 0, (4) Start Date must be valid date, (5) End Date must be after Start Date. Apply freeze panes to keep headers visible. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
